label: Roblox Studio
description: Roblox Studio Importer (File > Import 3D) with native glTF/GLB. Pre-scaled to studs so the importer's default Scale Unit (Stud) gives the right size.
importHints: File > Import 3D (or Home/Avatar tab > Import 3D) and pick the .glb.
File Geometry > Scale Unit: keep 'Stud' (this export is already in studs, 25:7 studs per meter).
Each material becomes its own MeshPart (Roblox allows one material per MeshPart); flat colors share one palette texture so they stay one MeshPart.
Colors come from textures because the Roblox glTF importer ignores baseColorFactor.

notes: Research (2026-10): glTF/GLB is supported natively by the Importer; FBX/OBJ conversion is not needed.
baseColorFactor is not preserved by the glTF importer (DevForum bug report), so every color is baked into a texture.
Each MeshPart holds a single material; UVs must be in 0..1 (Roblox texture specifications).
Meshes above 20,000 triangles are rejected by the Importer; 10,000 is the conservative mobile target.
SurfaceAppearance maps are capped at 1024x1024; normal maps are OpenGL tangent space (same as glTF).
Since 2026-06-16 the Importer converts non-stud units with 25:7 studs per meter; Scale Unit defaults to Stud.
Emissive and alpha blend mapping are unverified: check them with engines/roblox/CHECKLIST.md.
